name: print-social-matcha-candle-post-with-green-blobs-and-doodle-flowers
title: Matcha candle post: melting green shapes, pink and yellow title and matcha cutouts
whatItIs: A cream post with big wavy light-green blobs at the top holding cutouts of matcha ice cream, cupcake and iced latte. Justified green caps text sits over them, a bold pink 'MATCHA' and yellow italic 'CANDLE' title, a large white round candle, pink line-drawn flowers, and a green pill with a latte cup.
whatItMeans: Fresh and sweet; food cutouts tell the scent story.
techniques: Colour title words in pink and yellow, one in italic.
Show the hero product large in the middle.

vocabulary.definition: Images of ingredients that suggest a fragrance.
One word in italic to differ from its neighbour.
